#+TITLE: 10 fleet arcadia devbase
#+STARTUP: overview

* Dev process setup
  Before executing ANY work item in this plan, open and obey
  the rules defined in this project's per-repo instructions:

    - .github/copilot-instructions.md  (mirrored in CLAUDE.md)

  Both auto-load into every GHCP CLI session.  Read the current
  rules there and follow them.  This plan intentionally does
  not restate any rule — the per-repo instructions are the
  single source of truth.

* Goal [3/3]
      Bring the Arcadia devbase container environment to the requested
      model + lserver configuration, on BOTH the build source and the
      live fleet.

      Success criteria:
      - [X] The Arcadia devbase build-source ~/.bashrc pins
            COPILOT_MODEL="claude-opus-5", carries
            LSERVER_IP="172.25.159.143", and its h alias agrees on the
            model — in BOTH synchronized copies.
      - [X] Every live container in the fleet (c01–c05) exports
            COPILOT_MODEL="claude-opus-5" in its running ~/.bashrc,
            verified by an independent read-back sweep.
      - [X] The SHIPPED bundle cluster/archive/amd64.arcadia.dev.base.azl3.0.tar.gz
            contains usr/bin/git-lfs (rebuilt + republished 2026-10-09).

* Dependencies
      - The Arcadia devbase build folder, kept in two synchronized copies:
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/.bashrc" 1)
            (link "/root/etc/el/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/.bashrc" 1)
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/Dockerfile" 1)
            (link "/workspace/dot-emacs/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/tar.sh" 1)
      - The current fleet_ssh wrapper (supports the container tier and -R):
            (link "/workspace/cluster/.github/skills/fleet_ssh/fleet-ssh.sh" 1)
            (link "/workspace/cluster/.github/skills/fleet_ssh/recipes.sh" 1)
      - A reachable fleet: c01–c05, container tier landing on each box.

* Context
      Facts established on 2026-09-19:

      - The Arcadia devbase build exists as TWO copies of the SAME build,
        which must stay byte-identical: a jovyan-owned copy under
        /workspace/dot-emacs/build/... and a root-owned mirror under
        /root/etc/el/build/... . Every build-source edit is applied to
        both.

      - git-lfs and htop were ALREADY present in the devbase build SOURCE
        before this session: Dockerfile lines 43 (git-lfs) and 50 (htop),
        and tar.sh PKGS list plus the runtime-lib loop. CORRECTION
        2026-10-09: true for the source, FALSE for the shipped bundle --
        cluster/archive/amd64.arcadia.dev.base.azl3.0.tar.gz (583e2ef,
        Sep 26) had NO usr/bin/git-lfs (stale build), so 25/27 reachable
        containers lacked git-lfs and LFS checkouts stayed pointers. See
        Phase "git-lfs in shipped dev.base".

      - LSERVER_IP did not previously exist anywhere in the build. The
        devbase reaches lserver via
        COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL="http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1"
        (a hostname). Per the user's ruling, LSERVER_IP was ADDED as a
        standalone export and the base URL was LEFT AS-IS.

      - Editing the build-source ~/.bashrc does NOT change already-running
        containers. The build source sets what NEW container images bake;
        existing containers keep their own ~/.bashrc until rebuilt or
        edited live. The pre-fix container sweep showed c02=claude-opus-5
        and c01/c03/c04/c05=claude-opus-4-8 — proof the build edit had not
        propagated.

      - The container tier is read/written with the CURRENT wrapper's
        container tier. The build-source edit and the live-container edit
        are two DISTINCT actions; both were required to satisfy the Goal.

      :decision: Add LSERVER_IP as a standalone export and leave
                 COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL on host.docker.internal.
      :rejected: Rewriting the base URL to dial 172.25.159.143 directly —
                 the user asked only for the LSERVER_IP variable, not for
                 the CLI to consume it. Nothing currently reads LSERVER_IP;
                 if the CLI must dial the IP later, the base URL line is
                 what would reference $LSERVER_IP.
      :rejected: Editing git-lfs/htop into the build — already present.

* DONE fix: build-source ~/.bashrc [3/3]
      The devbase build source, edited in BOTH synchronized copies.

      - [X] Add LSERVER_IP to the build-source ~/.bashrc (both copies).
            Placed immediately after COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL (line 101):
                102:export LSERVER_IP="172.25.159.143"
      - [X] Bump the default model export from claude-opus-4-8 to
            claude-opus-5 (both copies):
                105:export COPILOT_MODEL="claude-opus-5"
      - [X] Confirm the h alias already agrees on the model (no edit
            needed): 115:alias h="... --model claude-opus-5".

      :verify: grep the two copies and confirm identical, correct lines:
        for f in \
          /workspace/dot-emacs/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/.bashrc \
          /root/etc/el/build/devbox-arcadia-azurelinux-3.0-photon-5.0/.bashrc; do
          grep -nE 'LSERVER_IP|COPILOT_MODEL|alias h=' "$f"; done

* DONE fix: live-container default model [2/2]
      The running containers on c01–c05 — a WRITE fanned out over the
      container tier, then an independent read-back. This is the
      propagation the build-source edit does NOT do on its own.

      - [X] Fan out an idempotent in-place edit that sets
            COPILOT_MODEL="claude-opus-5" in each running container's
            ~/.bashrc:
                fleet-ssh.sh -t ctr set='sed -i -E \
                  "s|^export COPILOT_MODEL=.*|export COPILOT_MODEL=\"claude-opus-5\"|" \
                  ~/.bashrc && grep -m1 "^export COPILOT_MODEL=" ~/.bashrc \
                  | sed "s/^export COPILOT_MODEL=//; s/\"//g"'
      - [X] :test_tool: Independent read-back sweep confirms every box:
                fleet-ssh.sh -t ctr model='grep -m1 "^export COPILOT_MODEL=" \
                  ~/.bashrc | sed "s/^export COPILOT_MODEL=//; s/\"//g" || echo -'
            Result — all five now claude-opus-5:
                BOX  MODEL
                c01  claude-opus-5
                c02  claude-opus-5
                c03  claude-opus-5
                c04  claude-opus-5
                c05  claude-opus-5

* DONE record durable finding
      - [X] The reusable lesson — "a build-source ~/.bashrc edit does NOT
            propagate to already-running containers; the live tier is a
            separate write" — is captured in this plan's Context and in the
            live-container fix group above. If it recurs across builds,
            promote it to .github/REPL/fix.archive/ with a short name.

            the pinned SHA directly (git fetch --depth 1 URL $CALAMINE_SHA);
            pin unchanged.  Bundle 49 MB -> 78 MB (current source now also
            ships perl closure + terminfo the stale build lacked).
      - [X] :test_tool: clean container

            tar -zxf BUNDLE -C / && git lfs version
